description: This source file contains utility functions related to network host identification, specifically identifying whether a given hostname or IP address corresponds to a local or private (LAN) gateway, loopback, or emulator environment. It includes functions to parse IP addresses, check if the host is a loopback or private LAN address, and detect if the code is running on an Android emulator.

methods.name: isLoopbackGatewayHost
methods.description: Determines if the provided host string refers to a loopback address (localhost, 127.x.x.x, ::1, etc.)

methods.name: isPrivateLanGatewayHost
methods.description: Determines if the provided host string refers to a private LAN address (e.g., 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, or link-local addresses)

methods.name: isAndroidEmulatorRuntime
methods.description: Detects if the code is running on an Android emulator or testing environment based on device build properties

methods.name: parseIpv4Address
methods.description: Parses IPv4 address string into a byte array if valid

methods.name: isIpv6LiteralChar
methods.description: Checks if a character is a valid IPv6 address character
